source.name: Electric power sales and revenue by state and sector, monthly

checks: complete 2019-2025 EIA snapshot has 5,208 unique state-month records
51 state and DC series each contain all 84 months
annual prices recomputed as 100 times summed revenue divided by summed sales
the U.S. aggregate rose from 10.68 to 13.41 cents per kWh, a 25.6% nominal increase
state comparisons exclude EIA census regions and the U.S. aggregate row
all three charts regenerate from the hash-checked local snapshot

evidenceBoundary: EIA average retail prices include utility revenue from delivered electricity, but do not show an individual site's tariff, load profile, contract price, itemized charges, or realized cost savings.
